info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Package registry is your container and package registry: push images, pull them back, see what you store.

get.summary: Images lists the org's container repositories, read live from the OCI catalog and filtered server-side to the org's namespace — the page can only ever hold the caller's own images.
get.description:
Images lists the org's container repositories, read live from the OCI
catalog and filtered server-side to the org's namespace — the page can only
ever hold the caller's own images.

get.summary: Packages lists the org's npm packages — `<org>` and `@<org>/…` — from the npm registry's search index, optionally narrowed by a query within that scope.
get.description:
Packages lists the org's npm packages — `<org>` and `@<org>/…` — from the
npm registry's search index, optionally narrowed by a query within that
scope. The org boundary is applied server-side after the search, so a query
can never widen it.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
Query narrows the listing within the org's scope when present; the org
boundary itself is never widened by it. It rides the query string.

get.summary: Projects lists the namespaces the caller can see with what each holds: the org's slug, its repository count on the OCI catalog, and its package count on the npm registry.
get.description:
Projects lists the namespaces the caller can see with what each holds: the
org's slug, its repository count on the OCI catalog, and its package count
on the npm registry. Today that is exactly one row — the caller's org.

get.summary: Status reports whether the OCI and npm registries are reachable and, when the OCI half is auth-gated, which token realm its challenge advertises — an honest lens for "is the registry plane up", never a fabricated ok.
get.description:
Status reports whether the OCI and npm registries are reachable and, when
the OCI half is auth-gated, which token realm its challenge advertises — an
honest lens for "is the registry plane up", never a fabricated ok.

get.summary: Tags lists one org-owned repository's tags, read live from the OCI registry.
get.description:
Tags lists one org-owned repository's tags, read live from the OCI registry.
The repository is addressed inside the org's namespace — a name outside it
cannot be expressed, and an unknown one answers 404.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description:
Image is the repository name inside the org's namespace, as returned by
the images op. It rides the query string.

post.summary: Token mints a short-lived, pull-only registry token for exactly one of the org's images, through the same IAM realm the docker CLI authenticates against.
post.description:
Token mints a short-lived, pull-only registry token for exactly one of the
org's images, through the same IAM realm the docker CLI authenticates
against. The scope is pinned server-side to `<org>/<image>` with the `pull`
action — no field exists to name another org's image or ask for push. Use it
as `Authorization: Bearer …` on the OCI wire; it expires in minutes.

name.description: Name is the repository name inside the org's namespace (e.g. "cloud").

ref.description:
Ref is the full pullable reference (host + org + name) the docker CLI
takes verbatim.

truncated.description:
Truncated is true when the catalog walk hit its page bound before the
registry was exhausted — the list is a prefix, not the whole.

image.description: Image is the repository name inside the org's namespace (e.g. "cloud").

description.description: Description says what the package is, as published.

name.description: Name is the package name (`<org>` or `@<org>/…`).

updated.description: Updated is when the package last changed, as the registry reports it.

version.description: Version is the latest published version.

data.description: Data is the packages in the org's scope.

images.description: Images is how many of the org's repositories the OCI catalog holds.

packages.description: Packages is how many of the org's packages the npm registry reports.

project.description:
Project is the namespace: the org's slug, which prefixes its image names
and scopes its npm packages.

data.description: Data is the namespaces visible to the caller.

host.description: Host is the OCI registry host clients push to and pull from.

oci.description: Oci is true when the OCI registry answered its /v2/ probe.

pkg.description: Pkg is true when the npm registry answered its ping.

pkgHost.description: PkgHost is the npm registry host.

realm.description:
Realm is the token endpoint the OCI registry's challenge advertises,
present only when the registry is reachable and auth-gated.

service.description: Service is the token service name from the same challenge.

data.description: Data is the tag names, as the registry reports them.

image.description: Image is the repository name inside the org's namespace.

ref.description: Ref is the full repository reference the tags belong to.

expires.description: Expires is the token's lifetime in seconds.

ref.description: Ref is the one repository reference the token can pull.

token.description:
Token is the bearer to present on the OCI wire
(`Authorization: Bearer …` against the host's /v2/ routes).

bearer.description: The caller's credential, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It is either an access token minted by Hanzo IAM or an API key (pk-/sk-). X-Authorization, and HTTP Basic carrying the token as the password, are accepted spellings of the same header for clients that cannot set Authorization; a browser presents the session cookie instead. Every operation requires it unless it says `security: []`.
